ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Distribution of approximately 60% high-intensity pixels (white) to 40% low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions located on the distal two-thirds of both lobes; low-intensity black pigmentation forms a solid central shape extending from the lower visible boundary to the notch, with irregular black striations interspersed in the white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped indentation with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 115 degrees and moderate depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous sequence of irregular peaks and valleys along the trailing boundary; serration frequency is consistent across the edge with pixel height variations ranging from 3 to 15 pixels, appearing most jagged at the distal ends.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve profile along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Brown-toned, high-texture pixel clusters located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; isolated small dark circular spots scattered within the white fields.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct set of parallel dark-gray linear pixel interruptions (rake marks) on the left lobe; multiple individual non-parallel dark scratches visible on the right lobe pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Textured brownish-yellow protrusions at the left and right distal tips; distinct linear rake marks on the ventral surface of the left lobe white field.
